zoe (VP Eng): quick post-all-hands note Thanks for the runtime questions. two tiny clarifications requested: 1) what exact batching guardrail for low-latency routes, and 2) who handles day-to-day kernel-v4 perf followups?

sam (Runtime): low-latency guardrail = max_delay 6ms, max_batch 10. we'll auto-shrink delay when p95 > baseline +2ms. config exposed per-route.

miri (Kernel): i'll own the day-to-day perf triage for kernel-v4 (hotspots, micro-PRs). sam handles rollout/canary infra.

azh (SRE): small ask: please add a console alert that flags p95 delta >2ms for 5min so we can human-check before auto-fallback.

sam (Runtime): yep will add alert + canary dashboard widget. auto-fallback: reduce batching tier -> if still breach, switch to v3-compatible binary.

zoe (VP Eng): thanks. action items: sam = dashboard + runbook, miri = perf kanban, ash = preflight smoke, docs team will publish a 1-pager. ping me if you want to join the canary readiness call tomorrow. :rocket:
